title: Are Agents Ready to Teach? A Multi-Stage Benchmark for Real-World Teaching Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2605.14322v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language agents are increasingly deployed in professional workflows, yet tutoring remains a high-stakes capability that existing evaluations only partially capture. Effective tutor agents require more than producing correct answers or executing accurate tool calls: they must infer a warranted teaching decision from evidence, adapt support as learner state changes, and carry an instructor's request through a learning-management system (LMS) to a completed, verified intervention. We introduce TeachArena, a source-grounded benchmark that jointly evaluates three complementary surfaces of teaching work: professional pedagogical judgment, situated multi-turn tutoring, and end-to-end LMS teaching workflows. Its 354 audited tasks are each built around a pedagogical insight, grounded in evidence, and evaluated with matched verifiers over observable turn-level responses, tutoring trajectories, and persistent artifacts or environment states. translated_title: 智能体准备好教学了吗？面向真实世界教学工作流的多阶段基准测试
translated_abstract: 语言智能体正日益被部署到专业工作流程中，然而辅导教学仍然是一项高风险能力，现有评估仅能部分覆盖。有效的辅导智能体需要的不仅仅是生成正确答案或执行准确的工具调用：它们必须从证据中推断出有依据的教学决策，随着学习者状态的变化调整支持力度，并将教师的请求通过学习管理系统（LMS）执行到已完成并经过验证的干预措施。我们提出了TeachArena，一个基于真实来源的基准测试，它共同评估教学工作的三个互补维度：专业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导，以及端到端的LMS教学工作流。其354个经过审核的任务，每一个都围绕一个教学洞察构建，以证据为基础，并使用匹配的验证器对可观察的轮次级响应、辅导轨迹以及持久化的产物或环境状态进行评估。
tldr: 本文提出TeachArena基准，通过354个基于真实来源的审核任务，从专业教学判断、情境化多轮辅导和端到端LMS教学工作流三个互补维度共同评估语言智能体的教学能力。
